# CHANGELOG

## [1.1.1] — 2025-06-25

- Added 'pointer-events: none' to <svg> inside trigger to improve clickability

## [1.1.0] — 2025-05-01

- Added option to disable close off by clicking anchor link using data attribute 'data-off-anchors="false"'

## [1.0.9] — 2025-04-30

- Added option to disable focus back on the trigger using data attribute 'data-off-focus="false"'

## [1.0.8] — 2025-04-27

- Close all active offs if active off not found 
- Changed default value of the property '--off--transition--duration' 
- Changed default value of the property '--off--transition--timing-function'
- Set custom off transition duration by parameter [data-off-duration="500"]

## [1.0.7] — 2025-03-25

- Changed default value of the property '--off--transition--duration' 

## [1.0.6] — 2025-03-11

- Added option to open off by hash in an url 

## [1.0.5] — 2024-12-05

- Improved 'dialog' type styles
- Fixed 'overlay' close 

## [1.0.4] — 2024-11-25

- Added 'dialog' type styles

## [1.0.3] — 2024-10-16

- Added 'data-inert' attribute to use the 'inert' parameter on off

## [1.0.2] — 2023-12-16

- Renamed transition properties

## [1.0.1] — 2023-10-11

- Fixed swipe on Y direction collision with scrolling

## [1.0.0] — 2023-02-28

- Initial release
